running_thesis: Fri 20 Nov (Cboe): S&P 500 and Dow in correction, Nasdaq Composite -5.3%, Nasdaq 100 near bear territory. Nvidia fell nearly 14% on SEC accounting-probe reports and ANT fell more than 9%. VIX 35.89, VXN 45.25, COR1M 36.05, VVIX 138.03. Yields fell (10-year 4.92%) on flight to safety while Polymarket prices a 25 bp hike on 9 Dec at 92.5%. NVDA 8-K: Huang reinstated as CEO on 22 Nov. Headlines point to a Monday bounce (unverified); Cboe warns a rebound may be only a reset. HY OAS 3.52 on 19 Nov. ANT options start 23 Nov. Oil data stale to 17 Nov.
open_questions: Does the Monday bounce hold, or is this a bear-market leg?
Does the Huang reinstatement calm the AI complex, or does the SEC probe spread (AMD allegations open)?
Do credit spreads keep widening after five straight wider prints to 19 Nov?
Do 50+ bp hike odds rise before 9 Dec, or does the equity damage soften the Fed?
